title.narrative: Classroom Mats of the Cardinal Directions

description.narrative: The aim of this project is to promote the livelihood of traditional Marshallese women artists in mat-weaving by recognizing their work as producers of classroom learning materials for teachers and students in Grade 2 Classrooms in the Marshall Islands. Its main objectives are : to promote traditional arts of women through recognizing their knowledge and skills as economic resources: produce a quantity of mats sufficient to supply the respective classrooms: train teachers in how to use the mats in their lessons; and distribute these mates to the respective teachers.
